sourcePrintedPages.verification: Complete book: printed p. 52–62 = physical pages 54–64; rendered printed footers inspected.

goals: Ei en Ek berekenen en hun teken uitleggen
Inferieur, normaal, luxe; substituten en complementen onderscheiden
Bij Ek vraaggoed en prijsgoed noemen
Functie invullen met gegeven eenheden; één factor wijzigen en vorige verandering terugzetten

startSupport.1: Retrieval of percentages and simple substitution. Fragile knowledge: offer old-value formula and substitute-before-multiplication scaffold if needed. Chapter teacher guide lists Book 1 origin; §2.2.1 p. 37 demonstrates percentages. Re-teach both operations in slides 3–4 with authored data.
startSupport.2: First encounter with formal Ei, Ek and multi-variable ceteris paribus. Shared overview explicitly points to theory p. 53–56; notes direct 2a to definitions p. 53–54, 2b to scenarios p. 55–56. Return after teaching and before independent practice.

authoredExamples.substitution: Illustrative lending visits Qv=460−12P; P=15 gives 280 visits/week.
authoredExamples.income: Fictional music-shop study: income +8%; concert packages +12%, sheet music +4%, budget CDs −4%; Ei +1.5,+0.5,−0.5.
authoredExamples.cross: Fictional separate e-reader studies: price +20%, paper novels +6%, matching covers −8%; later separate price −20%, novels −6%, covers +8%; Ek +0.3 and −0.4.
authoredExamples.function: LeesClub X: Qx=160−4Px+2Pz+0.01Y, Px=15,Pz=20,Y=26000; Q0=400. Y=28600 gives Q=426,Ei=.65. Reset Y=26000; Pz=25 gives Q=410.
authoredExamples.combined: Separate fictional studies: paper-book price +10% and e-reader demand +4%; matching-cover price +20% and e-reader demand −3%; no joint model.

targetCoverage.questions: Complete preamble, all three sources, all subquestions a–e and points shown before first solution. Answers follow textbook model.

scope: Classroom PPTX + matching PDF only; scoped Part B, not full companion completeness.
timing: No measured single-lesson claim; teacher guide allows extra time, especially §2.2.3.
